claim_boundary: fixed-weight test of an upstream cue-pair order contrast under an identical final cue-pair; no channel, routing, adaptation, learning, geometric-mechanism, or causal claim
target_rule: Each condition applies its exact listed permutation jointly to symbols and reliabilities. Base and heldout paired histories retain the same complete symbol-reliability evidence-pair multiset and public log-odds target, subject to recorded floating-point tolerance 1e-12.
fitting_rule: For every condition, fit the projection, cue6 decoder, normalization, and temporal tracker solely on base-order train32. Apply unchanged objects to paired heldout eval32. No heldout-order state, label, transform, or threshold may fit an object.
primary_outcome: At delay8, compare seed-median true tracked R2 between final05_base and final05_upstream_swap12. Continuous margin and its true-minus-latest and true-minus-shuffle components are secondary. Identity is a recency reference only.
seed_level_aggregation: For each condition and parameter seed, use the median across three fixed projection seeds. Projection and checkpoint cells are dependent descriptive measurements.
decision_rule: An upstream order effect is observed only if final05_base minus final05_upstream_swap12 has the same nonzero true-R2 direction in at least three of four seeds at delay8. Regardless of outcome, do not nominate geometry or channels unless an independent fresh confirmation is later run.
